seoTitle: Coupon Code Generator: Batches of Unique Discount Codes
metaDescription: Generate unique random discount codes with a prefix, length, character set and dashes using browser crypto. Free, private.
intro: Generates a batch of random, unique coupon codes with the prefix, length and character set you choose.
why:
Guessable coupon codes get abused. Codes that are random and long enough to make guessing impractical, with look-alike characters removed, are safer and easier to read out loud.

The tool uses the browser crypto random source with rejection sampling, so every character is equally likely. It refuses a batch if the code space is too small for the count, and it never repeats a code within a batch. It cannot check against codes already in your shop.
howTo: Set how many codes you need.
Set prefix, length, dash grouping and character set.
Copy the list and import it into your shop.

faq.q: How long should a code be?
faq.a: Eight random letters and digits give a very large space, which is enough for most promos.
O, I and the digits 0 and 1 are left out to avoid confusion.

faq.q: Will it avoid codes I already used?
faq.a: No. Compare against your existing list.
